:::{#def-bic}
#### Bayesian information criterion (BIC)

Let a model with $\nparams$ estimated parameters be fitted by [maximum likelihood](intro-MLEs.qmd#def-mle) to $\nobs$ observations,
and let $\llikf{\est{\vparam}}$ be the [log-likelihood](intro-MLEs.qmd#def-loglik) at the [maximum likelihood estimate](intro-MLEs.qmd#def-mle) $\est{\vparam}$.
The **Bayesian information criterion** of the model is

$$
\text{BIC} \eqdef -2 \llikf{\est{\vparam}} + \nparams \logf{\nobs}.
$$

It is minus twice the maximized log-likelihood, plus $\logf{\nobs}$ for each estimated parameter.
A smaller BIC is better.

Source: @schwarz1978estimating.
:::
